snippet.title: Well Dweller ► RELEASE DATE REVEAL
snippet.description:
Deep within the forest, at the bottom of a well, lives the only creature brave enough to challenge the queen. Well Dweller launches on September 22 for PC, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, the Xbox family, and Xbox Game Pass!

From the creator of indie hits Crypt Custodian and Islets, and revealed in Nintendo Indie World, comes Well Dweller - a new dark, bizarre, twisted fairy-tale metroidvania. Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick - who must burn the wicked queen to save his family before they become part of her royal gown. Venture forth into a whimsical but morbid fairy-tale landscape, and battle terrifying beasts whilst gaining new abilities to expand your world. Discover secrets, mysteries, and the riddles that rot in the underbelly of this wretched queendom.

The dark nooks and crannies throughout shelter powerful trinkets that are key to survival, and a cast of charming characters and allies - all trying to make their own way through the Queen’s twisted world - await befriending along your journey. As you explore the interconnected world, you'll use various skills and new abilities to uncover more of the decaying Queendom’s mysteries, and just how it came to be. Not every fable or fairly-tale has a happy ending, and an imposing collection of beast and royally-sized challenges await. Step into the tiny shoes (or feathers) of Glimmer, and perhaps, just perhaps, you’ll be able to re-unite all your sheltered siblings, snatched from the nest one night in a turn of events that lead to the coming of an unlikely, little hero....

Features:
- A beautifully hand-drawn, dark fairy-tale contrasting a wretched kingdom with charming characters
- Use your matchstick to both fight through and traverse this massive interconnected world 
- Mix-and-match trinkets to tailor your playstyle with collectible abilities
- Discover and piece together broken storybooks which tell the story of the tragedies which befell the Queendom
- Gain new abilities for both you and your matchstick to unlock new areas, and discover hidden secrets
- Befriend quirky characters throughout the lands, such Ilda the mouse and Looter the scavenger.
